_comment: Hand-curated rules. Every entry is traceable to a developers.home-assistant.io post
or to a file in home-assistant/core, quoted in the 'message' and linked in 'source'.
These exist because the announcement is prose only -- there is no report_usage() call
in core carrying a string-literal breaks_in_ha_version for them, so tools/extract_rules.py
Rules with matchable=false ship as information only: they appear on the board so a user
knows the release is coming, but the crawler will not claim a repo is affected.
Curation policy (see README 'How rules are chosen'): a matcher is only enabled when the
symbol is specific enough that a hit is almost certainly the deprecated API, and the
measured hit-rate across the real crawl is plausible rather than universal.

rules.message: Implements the legacy (non-config-entry) device tracker platform API. 'The legacy (non-config-entry) device tracker platform API is deprecated and will be removed in the Home Assistant 2027.5 release.' Migrate to the modern device tracker platform API (config entry + ScannerEntity/TrackerEntity).
Subclasses homeassistant.components.device_tracker.DeviceScanner, part of the legacy device tracker platform API removed in Home Assistant 2027.5. Migrate to ScannerEntity on a config entry.

'The battery_level property has been deprecated in all device tracker base classes, and will stop working in Home Assistant Core 2027.7.' Expose the battery as a separate sensor entity with device_class battery instead.

'The location_name property of TrackerEntity has been deprecated, and will stop working in Home Assistant Core 2027.7.' Set the entity state from latitude/longitude and let Home Assistant resolve the zone.

'The dedicated home_assistant_start flag of async_initialize_triggers is deprecated and will be removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8.' Listen for the homeassistant_started event from the trigger itself instead.
DeviceEntry.primary_config_entry is deprecated and removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8 -- 'Deprecated, use DeviceEntry.config_entry_id instead.' Devices are now restricted to a single config entry.

'The add_config_entry_id, add_config_subentry_id, remove_config_entry_id and remove_config_subentry_id parameters are all deprecated.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8; use new_config_entry_id / new_config_subentry_id.
DeviceInfo['via_device'] and DeviceRegistry.async_get_or_create(via_device=...) are deprecated -- 'Deprecated, use via_device_id instead.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8.

DeviceRegistry.async_get_device() is deprecated -- 'Identifiers and connections are only unique per config entry.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8; use async_get_device_by_identifier() or async_get_device_by_connection().

DeviceEntry.config_entries is deprecated -- 'Deprecated, use DeviceEntry.config_entry_id instead.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8. Detected only where the receiver is proven to be a DeviceEntry (a registry lookup, a DeviceEntry annotation, or the async_remove_config_entry_device contract); hass.config_entries is never flagged.
